opportunity.title: Seeking PhD opportunities for Fall 2027
opportunity.text: I am seeking PhD opportunities for Fall 2027, and welcome conversations about research fit and collaboration.

experience.institution: Siebel School of Computing and Data Science, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
experience.topic: Investigating physics-aware 3D reconstruction from motion-degraded imagery through inverse rendering, with physically based forward models describing image formation and learned priors constraining the recovery of underlying scene geometry.

experience.institution: Computational Design and Fabrication Group, MIT CSAIL
experience.topic: Developed FlowPDE for neural PDE solving, connecting conditional flow matching with classical iterative solvers. Studied solution prediction on complex geometries for fully specified PDEs and conditional solution distributions under partial observations.

experience.institution: Intelligent Graphics Lab, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
experience.topic: Worked on QuadLink, generating editable quad-dominant meshes from point clouds through autoregressive vertex and face-centroid prediction, learned connectivity modeling, and geometric verification for anisotropic meshes with coherent edge flow.

experience.institution: Institute of CG and CAD, Tsinghua University
experience.topic: Researched facial appearance capture from in-the-wild smartphone videos through WildCap and OpenDelight, combining learned delighting priors with model-based inverse rendering to recover detailed facial reflectance maps for photorealistic relighting.

experience.institution: Metaverse AI Interdisciplinary Innovation Lab, Tsinghua University
experience.topic: Explored 3D scene generation and light-field rendering for immersive displays. Work included M3DLayout, a multi-source dataset of indoor layouts and structured descriptions for text-conditioned generation, and light-field synthesis using NVIDIA OptiX.

projects.title: Echo of Time
projects.description: A three-player cross-time cooperative puzzle game built with Unity and C# for a software engineering course project. Players coordinate actions across different temporal states to solve spatial and logical puzzles.
